notes: CDER Office of Compounding Quality and Compliance letter for a 503B sterile outsourcing facility (Houston, TX): failure to meet section 503B conditions (missing 'This is a compounded drug' labeling statement, inadequate adverse-event-reporting procedures), adulteration from insanitary aseptic-processing conditions (blocked first air, inadequate media fills, deficient smoke studies, cracked LAFH plexiglass) plus separate CGMP citations (211.113(b) aseptic validation, 211.42(c)(10) EM/cleaning/equipment maintenance, 211.192 investigations, 211.22(d) QC unit, 211.125(a) labeling control, 211.63 equipment), a dedicated 'Unapproved New Drug Products' section (no approved 505 application), and misbranding (labeling lacks adequate directions for use). contamination_present is left false: the letter discusses insanitary-condition risk and inadequate EM alert/action CFU levels hypothetically ('any microbial contamination... is a serious concern and upon recovery...') but does not describe an actual confirmed contamination finding or organism. recall_concern is true because multiple sections direct the firm to assess risk/impact to already-distributed product. No FEI is stated (only WL # 713015).
